name: Offline - Field work offline sync capability
description: Verifies offline mode: queue management, IndexedDB storage, sync status indicators, and automatic recovery

planSteps.description: Log in and navigate to /dashboard/execution while connected
Use browser devtools to simulate offline mode (Network tab → Offline)
Assert that an offline banner appears indicating the app is in offline mode
Attempt to start an execution session offline
Assert that the action is queued locally and shows 'pending sync' indicator
Assert that the sync queue processes automatically and items show 'synced' status
Navigate to /dashboard/offline-sync to view the sync history and status
Assert that the offline sync page shows queued, syncing, and synced items with timestamps
